listing.title: My First Cars, Trains & Planes Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Vehicle Pages – Car, Steam Train, Airplane, Tugboat & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly cars, trains, planes and boats!

Little hands color 30 things that go on the road, on the rails, in the air and on the water, from a car, a school bus and a police car to a steam train, a helicopter and a tugboat. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines and a happy face, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • On the road: Car, Race Car, Bus, School Bus, Taxi, Police Car, Ambulance, Motorcycle and Ice Cream Van
  • On the rails and cables: Steam Train, Train Engine, High-Speed Train, Caboose, Tram and Cable Car
  • In the air: Airplane, Propeller Plane, Biplane, Seaplane, Helicopter, Blimp and Jet
  • On the water: Tugboat, Ferry, Cruise Ship, Speedboat, Fishing Boat, Rowboat, Kayak and Hovercraft
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
